title: pi-perm user configuration overlay
description: Overlay on shipped defaults.json, loaded at startup or /reload. Runtime validation additionally checks fixed modes, group references/conflicts, safe defaults/cycles, and mandatory safeguards. This is not the pi-permission-modes schema.

cycleOrder.description: Alt+M order; yolo requires explicit selection.

permissionGroups.description: Reusable tool permissions. Definitions replace shipped groups by name; nested group references are forbidden.

pi_perm_runtime.description: AUTOMATIC, NOT EDITABLE: enforcement facts refreshed before every agent turn in non-YOLO modes. No text template is accepted. Omit this entry to inherit it.

paths.description: Literal paths only; no globs. ~ and $HOME expand. Sandbox paths are project-relative; read paths in global config are agent-directory-relative.

oneOf.description: Glob map: last matching pattern wins. * crosses slashes; **/ also matches zero directories. Put * first. Numeric-only keys are forbidden by runtime validation.

groups.description: Selected permission groups. [] disables groups. Mode rules override group rules.

permission.description: read/grep/find/ls/write/edit match paths; path is a cross-cutting file/Bash gate; external_directory gates unapproved external reads; bash matches the ENTIRE submitted command line; tool matches other tool names; skill matches skill tool names; other keys match exact tools against JSON-serialized input. Missing rules ask; path defaults allow. Project rules can only tighten.

safeCommandRule.description: Tree-sitter-checked bare commands, not unrestricted command-name globs. Whole-line mode patterns override matching requests; scalar ask is the fallback. Adding commands explicitly trusts their behavior.

enabled.description: Must remain true except in yolo. No unavailable-sandbox fallback.

writable.description: Bash project writes. false leaves only private scratch writable. plan must keep false.

allowWrite.description: Project-relative literal writable roots; may only resolve within project or scratch. Scratch is always added.

systemPrompt.description: Replaces this mode's text in source=mode sections; inline or @file relative to config.json.

systemPromptAppend.description: Appended to systemPrompt. Inline or @file; no automatic recursive substitution.

source.description: text: this section's text. mode: selected mode's systemPrompt + systemPromptAppend.

when.description: sandboxed=every non-YOLO mode; always=including YOLO; never=disabled; array=only those mode IDs.

text.description: Only for source=text. Inline or @file relative to global config.json. Loaded on startup/reload, not every turn.
